notes.title: Updates and bug fix
notes.notes:
Thanks to @GripZ for the translation! 

list]
[*] Fixed an issue where props remained in place after the Hound of Tindalos moved
[*] Increased the upper limit of card slots on the field, up to 100
[*] Make insane to get the burn buff
[*] Added a prompt to see the storage function for the first time
[*] Fixed a text error with Moon Beast
[*] Fixed a bug where poison would not stack on investigators
[*] Fixed a bug where "King in Yellow" got a buff
[*] Set upper and lower limits on card rarity acquisition rates
[*] Completion achievements will be checked when entering the game
[*] Fixed a bug where ? in the Graveyard could be selected when selecting the Graveyard spell to return to the Deck Event
[*] Fixed an issue where music could occasionally be heard when the game failed, even with the volume turned off
[*] Make game speed also affect animation speed
[*] Fixed an issue where Vault cards were not saved when saving
[*] Endless mode adds an end game button
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when the relic pool was exhausted in Endless Mode
[*] Added a tutorial button prompt when entering the game for the first time
[*] Fixed an issue where the tribute value exceeded the data cap
[*] Removed the "King in Yellow" keyword displayed in theaters
[*] Fixed Endless Mode not adding investigators
[*] Fixed a bug in the description of the effect of the human-faced mouse
[*] Fixed an issue where getting too many tributes at one time caused the game to freeze
[*] Made Book of Eibon no longer spawn peers, ghoul gatherings and time ladders increase through the plot
[*] Fixed the bug that the "King in Yellow" on Naia did not trigger the theater
[*] Added the display of the number of draw piles and discard piles during the round
[*] The cards drawn in the round can now also stack the items that are not on the field
[*] Ghoul Gathering reduced rarity
[*] The ending cg needs to be clicked to finish the game, making it easier to view the picture
[*] Optimized the description of the effect of Mountains of Madness
[/list]
